title: O, rocks! she said. Tell us in plain words.
html_source: Molly is intentionally portrayed as earthy, in contrast with the male characters whose intellectual lives mean they are less in touch with their bodies, with the earth. Here, she is no intellectual and wants a simple explanation, while later making lewd jokes. Ulysses has attracted some criticism for its depiction of its major female character as being less cerebral than the men. Molly was probably based, in part, on Nora Joyce who, for all her sharp wit and smarts, was considered to keep James Joyce grounded.
